_doc: Single source for parameter → DSP mapping. Read by tools/render_voices.js (offline reference model) and tools/build_patches.py (Max voice patches). Exponential maps: v = lo * (hi/lo)^x. Values are first estimates — confirm by ear in Live (spec §07).

envelope._doc: ATTACK synth param maps exponentially to attackMs; then linear decay over decayMs; envelope = ramp squared

drive._doc: y = tanh(g*x) * comp, g = 1 + drive*gainMax, comp = g^(-compExp): unity for quiet signals at drive 0, RMS roughly constant across drive (calibrated by tools/render_voices.js)

texture._doc: src = (1-t)*white*whiteGain + t*pink*pinkGain + crackle(t)*crackleGain; crackle = sparse random impulses, density = crackleMax*t

METAL._doc: toneHz = fundamental of 4 inharmonic sine partials; noise excitation band-passed at 2.2×f0; texture = noise share

master._doc: fixed safety: out = tanh(sum * drive) * ceiling. Not a user control.

reso._doc: RESO synth param → svf~ resonance q = lo + (hi-lo)*reso

pan._doc: per-hit constant-power pan, centre gain = 1 (as mono v0.1): gl = sqrt2*cos(p*pi/2), gr = sqrt2*sin(p*pi/2), p = 0..1

HISS.label: BODY
HISS._doc: crossfade highpass → bandpass output (thin hiss → hat with body)

DUST.label: GRAIN
DUST._doc: c=0 smooth noise burst … c=1 sparse dust grains: noise gain = 1 - noiseCut*c, crackle density = dens[0] + (dens[1]-dens[0])*c (DUST ignores texture for crackle)

metalColor._doc: METAL: (mix + bandpass(mix)*k) / (1 + norm*k), k = reso*gain, bandpass at f0*noiseBpRatio with q from RESO — resonant coloration at stable level
